basic_info.description: Step into this exceptional single-level residence that combines the privacy of a home with the ease of condominium living. One of only three units in an exclusive boutique building, this rarely available gem offers two private outdoor spaces, including a beautifully landscaped backyard.    Positioned on the final block of Fell Street and surrounded by greenery, the home is flooded with southern light and features floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Panhandle. High ceilings, rich hardwood floors, radiant heating, and a wood-burning fireplace with a stone surround add warmth and a sense of spaciousness.    The layout includes three generous bedrooms, two elegantly appointed bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining areaideal for entertaining or relaxing in comfort.    Additional highlights include garage parking for two cars in tandem, a private storage closet, and well-maintained shared spaces that reflect pride of ownership.    Located just blocks from Golden Gate Park, Whole Foods, USF, UCSF, and a vibrant mix of cafes, shops, and restaurants, with easy access to main thoroughfares.    A rare opportunity to own a truly special home in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. Rare opportunity not to be missed.
